execute_read_query.rationale: Reviewed: read-only SQL can expose production data and is governed at medium impact.

execute_write_query.rationale: Reviewed: executes arbitrary INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and DDL against the selected database; a single call can irreversibly destroy production data or schema, so exact-argument approval is required.

get_insights.rationale: Reviewed: reads query-performance telemetry without mutating the database.

list_cluster_sizes.rationale: Reviewed: lists available cluster SKUs without changing infrastructure.

search_documentation.rationale: Reviewed: searches PlanetScale documentation without changing provider resources.
